tradeIdeas.title: iTraxx Asia IG CDS Protection - Reload; Compression Thesis Reversed
tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG remains about 138bp (Aug 5 estimate). Reuters reported at least five shipping incidents in the 48 hours before Oct 14 and two vessel sinkings near Hormuz; the latest comparable count remains seven commodity-vessel crossings on Oct 6. Maintain protection at 60-70%; stress (45%): 150-180bp; tail (40%): 200-230bp if attacks resume at scale. Reduce only after verified reopening and sustained traffic normalisation.
instruments: Sapura Energy / Hyflux bond short via CDS (maintain)

tradeIdeas.rationale: iTraxx Asia IG ~138bp (Aug 5 estimate) and ASEAN Banks ~207.5 idx / ASEAN Energy ~116 remain estimates. Brent is $104.39 and WTI $93.98 (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15). Hold the energy underweight; reopen a banks long only after a verified reopening and sustained credit compression. Tail probability remains 40%.
instruments: ASEAN Banks ETF (hold neutral, no long)
